basis.label: UPS: 10 years
basis.note: Printed page 275. Electrical infrastructure section. Section 6.2.4 (p.348) also gives 'UPS device: 10 years' and 'UPS batteries: 5 years' for network equipment. Minimum life expectancy (design requirement) for DfE-funded school buildings. Minimum design requirements placed on contractors for school buildings, not observed replacement ages. Section 5.1.4 (sanitaryware) refers to CIBSE Guide M Appendix 12.A1 'in general'.

basis.title: General depreciation rates (IR265), July 2021
basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Power supplies (uninterruptable)
basis.note: Printed page 47. Computers category. Spelling as printed. Printed DV 30%, SL 21%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.
